facts.fact: The Government of Liberia's REALISE Social Cash Transfer programme pays extremely poor families quarterly by MTN mobile money, with all transfers delivered digitally (REALISE Project, Government of Liberia).

The Liberia Household Social Registry, held by the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection with over 442,000 poverty-ranked households, supplies the households enrolled into the Social Cash Transfer, per the REALISE Project.
